title: Korevix's Indestructium
description: Ultra buffed endgame tools for massive modpacks
body:
Korevix’s Indestructium adds new endgame tools. The tools themselves have absurd mining speeds, more than you would ever need, and insane durability to keep up with mining literal chunks away.

And so the goal of the mod is to add a higher tier of progression that is meant to last, and to combat the high-tech machinery found in mods like Create.

# What is added

- Kunzite - Found in the Nether within Netherrack and Blackstone
- Calcedony - Found in the End within Endstone and Blackstone (For modded Biomes)
- Kunzite Block - This is one of the resources needed to craft an Indestructium tool
- Calcedony Block - This is one of the resources needed to craft an Indestructium tool
- Diamond Hilt - Made with 2 diamonds respectively, the handle is meant to take on the strength of the tool itself, as a stick is just too nimble
- Indestructium Tools - Depending on the tool itself, all of them have 77,800 Durability, and more than enough mining speeds to where they can do nearly anything without enchants

# For Modpacks
This mod is explicitly balanced for large-scale modpacks and is not intended/balanced for a vanilla-friendly experience. And so with that, it is best paired with end-game like modpacks.


If you want to use this in a video or modpack, feel free to do so; I don’t require credit.
